kind: Installation identity, executable observations and OpenJK reference observations for the Jedi Academy startup contracts
statusAtRecord: experimental; default builds rejected the profiles, -Djka-development=true activated them for isolated probes
claims: no Jedi Academy module, wire, savegame, asset or renderer boundary existed at this slice; no gameplay or interoperability claim

observations.singlePlayerModuleLocation: installation root beside jasp.exe, not base/; exports GetGameAPI, dllEntry, vmMain

multiplayerModules.location: inside paks; base/ carries no loose module
multiplayerModules.assets3.pk3: 1.01 patch; newer copies of all three
multiplayerModules.exports: dllEntry and vmMain only (Quake III native shape)
multiplayerModules.method: only the export tables were parsed; no module was loaded

reference.name: OpenJK
reference.use: reference observation only; no implementation text incorporated

factKinds.contractBound: protocol numbers, module entry points and names, configstring layouts, limits, BSP identity
factKinds.engineDefaultValues: sv_pure, sv_maxclients, fraglimit and the userinfo defaults; each stays open until a retail observation confirms it

retailCompatibilityBranch.effect: defined by default; reserves the 96 configstrings a retail single-player build carries; fnTech3 follows it

jka-sp.moduleAbi: GetGameAPI function table plus the client game's dllEntry/vmMain from the same library
jka-sp.nativeModule: jagamex86.dll (game and client game; no menu module)
jka-sp.serverDefaults: no game type, one client slot, no frag limit
jka-sp.bots: none; single player runs the game module's own AI and no bot library

jka-mp.moduleAbi: Quake III dllEntry/vmMain native shape, observed in all six installed modules

shared.qvm: none; codemp/qcommon has no VM back end to run one
shared.steam: none recorded; discovery reports no path rather than guessing an AppID or folder
shared.entityHulls: caller-supplied trace shape, as Quake III uses

installationIdentity.rule: exactly one default.cfg of 2178 bytes with CRC fb11a25b and exactly one mpdefault.cfg of 2845 bytes with CRC 4999454a, and no other title's companion name
installationIdentity.detection: reports that a mode must be chosen, as an RTCW or Elite Force installation with both modes does
installationIdentity.notUsedBecause: names Quake III and Quake Live installations carry too

protocolSharing.mechanism: Com_ProtocolFamilyForVersion returns every family that uses the number; each profile admits only its own family
protocolSharing.beforeEnforcement: the contract fnql::protocol::Find chose for a number was used without asking whose it was
protocolSharing.checkedBy: tests/game_profile_tests.cpp (no contract serves either Jedi title)

notClaimed: Steam AppID, install directory or discovery behavior
retail pak identity, file count or asset inventory
wire codec (protocol 26 and 40 are registered numbers, not encoders)
module ABI (only module file names and entry-point shapes)
asset support (ICARUS scripts, .sav savegame format and Raven's shader extensions unimplemented at the slice)

openItems.detail: free-for-all is 0 but single player is 5 and team deathmatch 6 (codemp/game/bg_public.h:234); the inherited spmap set Quake III's single-player number, which would select Jedi Master
openItems.correction: retail jamp.exe 1.01 registers spmap, which selects 5, and fnTech3's now does the same (2026-10-06-jedi-listen-server-game-types.md)

openItems.detail: sv_pure, sv_maxclients, fraglimit and the userinfo defaults stay open until a retail observation confirms each one

netf_overrides.txt and psf_overrides.txt (ext_data/MP/ in assets1.pk3) are name-keyed overrides, not the delta tables: 130 entity fields listed where the engine's table has 132, 143 player fields where it has 152, different order, and disagreeing widths (entity weapon is 8 bits in the table and 32 in the file); the wire codec has to take its table from the engine contract and carry the override mechanism (codemp/qcommon/msg.cpp:1889)
sex, snd and handicap (code/client/cl_main.cpp:1296-1301) are savegame-carried and belong to the single-player client slice
